structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: The contract explicitly requires reuse of the existing student/me endpoints and the existing /inicio experience.

entries.plausible_wrong_implementation: A parallel endpoint or alternate student home could produce the right happy-path result while violating the explicit reuse contract.
entries.positive_evidence: Material source keeps /inicio and calls only /student/me/summary, /student/me/notifications and /student/me/profile-review.
entries.negative_control_evidence: NC-342-008 in requirement-attack-matrix.json proves no new backend/schema path and no alternate home were introduced.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: No new historical/read-model contract is introduced by this web entry-point issue.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: The existing student/me API remains the canonical source and the browser harness consumes the same client path.

documentation_consistency.applicability_reason: No product contract changed; docs/student-app-data-contract.md already documents the reused student/me endpoints.
search_evidence: docs/student-app-data-contract.md verified unchanged for this remediation.
